Top P2P Platforms

These are the top P2P platforms currently covered on P2P Insights. The list is ranked, and more rating details will be added as the platform coverage grows.

1

Mintos

Best overall for investors who want choice and control.

Read Mintos review

A broader investing platform with loans, bonds, real estate, ETFs, Smart Cash, and crypto ETPs from one account.

Best for
More product choice and control.
Watch
More complexity and product-specific risk.
2

IUVO Group

Best returns in our hands-on experience.

Read IUVO review

A flexible loan-receivables marketplace with manual investing, Auto Assign, a secondary market, and the strongest returns we have seen across the platforms covered here.

Best for
Return-focused investors who want portfolio control.
Watch
Occasional cart loading friction, slower bank transfers, and originator risk.
3

Bondora Go & Grow

Best for simple, hands-off P2P exposure.

Read Bondora review

A passive Go & Grow product for investors who want simple deposits, daily returns, and straightforward withdrawals.

Best for
Passive investors who want simplicity.
Watch
Lower return ceiling and platform conditions.
4

Robo.cash

Best for a fully automated, low-maintenance P2P approach.

Read Robo.cash review

A hands-off loan-investing platform with automated portfolios, an established repayment track record, and slower bank-transfer cash movement.

Best for
Investors who want to set a portfolio and leave it running.
Watch
No manual loan picking, 2–3 day bank transfers, and group concentration.
